description_en: Retrieves a dataset. Release version: v6.2.0
name: GetDataset

Directory.description_en: The directory (retrieved from the file service by using the fileId)
Directory.description_zh: 目录（通过fileId从文件服务获取）
Directory.title_en: 目录（通过fileId从文件服务获取）
Directory.title_zh: 目录（通过fileId从文件服务获取）

LockOwner.description_en: The ID of the development owner

LockOwnerName.description_en: The display name of the development owner on the interface
LockOwnerName.description_zh: 这个给界面显示的字段
LockOwnerName.title_en: 这个给界面显示的字段
LockOwnerName.title_zh: 这个给界面显示的字段

ProjectId.description_en: The ID of the project to which the dataset belongs

ProjectName.description_en: The name of the project to which the dataset belongs

Scenario.description_en:
The dataset scenarios. Valid values:
OFFLINE: offline (default).
REALTIME: real-time
Scenario.description_zh: 数据集使用场景: OFFLINE(离线，默认) / REALTIME(实时)
Scenario.title_en: 数据集使用场景: OFFLINE(离线，默认) / REALTIME(实时)
Scenario.title_zh: 数据集使用场景: OFFLINE(离线，默认) / REALTIME(实时)

DevPath.description_en: The development path (not required for basic projects)

MetadataStorageMode.description_en: The storage destination (new table or existing table)

ElementType.description_en: The array element subtype. This parameter is valid only when type is set to ARRAY
ElementType.description_zh: 数组元素子类型，仅当type=ARRAY时有效

MaxCapacity.description_en: The maximum array capacity. This parameter is valid only when type is set to ARRAY. Default value: 4096
MaxCapacity.description_zh: 数组最大容量，仅当type=ARRAY时有效，默认4096

Pk.description_en: Indicates whether the column is a primary key

Url.description_en: Indicates whether the column is a URL

IndexParams.description_en: The index build parameters. Different parameters are required depending on the index type. For example, HNSW requires {M:30, efConstruction:360}, and IVF_FLAT requires {nlist:128}
IndexParams.description_zh: 索引构建参数，根据indexType不同传入不同参数，如HNSW需{M:30, efConstruction:360}，IVF_FLAT需{nlist:128}

IndexType.description_en: The index type. PG supports IVFFlat and HNSW. Milvus supports all types
IndexType.description_zh: 索引类型，PG支持IVFFlat/HNSW，Milvus支持全部类型

SimilarityType.description_en: The similarity type. Default value: COSINE. COSINE corresponds to vector_cosine_ops, L2 corresponds to vector_l2_ops, and IP corresponds to vector_ip_ops
SimilarityType.description_zh: 相似度类型，默认COSINE。COSINE对应vector_cosine_ops，L2对应vector_l2_ops，IP对应vector_ip_ops

RealtimeMetaTableConfig.description_en: The real-time meta table configuration. This parameter takes effect only when metadataStorageType is set to REALTIME_META_TABLE
RealtimeMetaTableConfig.description_zh: 实时元表配置（仅当 metadataStorageType=REALTIME_META_TABLE 时生效）

DatasourceType.description_en: The data source type of the meta table. Only KAFKA is supported in the current release
DatasourceType.description_zh: 元表数据源类型（本期仅开放 KAFKA）
DatasourceType.title_en: 元表数据源类型（本期仅开放 KAFKA）
DatasourceType.title_zh: 元表数据源类型（本期仅开放 KAFKA）

ProjectId.description_en: The project ID to which the meta table belongs. Cross-project references are supported
ProjectId.description_zh: 元表所属项目ID（支持跨项目）
ProjectId.title_en: 元表所属项目ID（支持跨项目）
ProjectId.title_zh: 元表所属项目ID（支持跨项目）

Pk.description_en: Indicates whether the column is a primary key

Url.description_en: Indicates whether the column is a URL

RealtimeMetaTableConfig.title_en: 实时元表配置（仅当 metadataStorageType=REALTIME_META_TABLE 时生效）
RealtimeMetaTableConfig.title_zh: 实时元表配置（仅当 metadataStorageType=REALTIME_META_TABLE 时生效）

Message.description_en: The details of the backend exception

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
